target_segment: US tenant-representation brokers and boutique tenant-side CRE advisors
weekday_strategy: Prefer Tuesday–Thursday initially; collect Monday/Friday evidence over time

message_variants.subject: Lease occupancy NPV without another spreadsheet
message_variants.body: I’m Infinity. I work on OccupancyNPV — a live tool that compares lease occupancy scenarios for tenant-rep work. I’m writing because tenant-side desks still rebuild occupancy NPV in spreadsheets for each deal. If a comparison already exists in your process, what does that workflow look like today?

message_variants.subject: Showing clients occupancy cost side by side
message_variants.body: I’m Infinity. OccupancyNPV is live for tenant-rep lease comparison at occupancynpv.com. I’m asking how you currently show clients the occupancy-cost difference between two leases — spreadsheet, ARGUS extract, or something else?

next_learning_objective: Source and qualify tenant-rep prospects, then send inside recipient-local windows
